text:
marco: quick heads-up — saw a reproducible stall when cancelling a Retrofit suspend call on Pixel 8 + company VPN. coroutine cancels but the next request blocks for ~20s. anyone seen this? :thinking_face:
sofia: emulator or only on-device?
marco: only physical Pixel 8 so far. Pixel 5 and emulator fine.
james: are you using Retrofit suspend funcs (Kotlin) or enqueue?
marco: suspend functions. pattern: withContext(IO) { api.fetch() } then job.cancel() and immediately start another fetch which then hangs.
sofia: okhttp config? timeouts, connection pool?
marco: default OkHttpClient from SDK, connectTimeout 10s, readTimeout 0 (streaming), no callTimeout. HTTP/2 on.
marco: repro snippet:
```kotlin
val j = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { api.fetch() }
j.cancel()
api.fetch() // stalls
```
james: looks like a socket reuse/half-closed issue. quick hack: call.cancel() in coroutine cancellation hook or connectionPool.evictAll() after cancel.
marco: evictAll helped but not full. adding call.cancel() in invokeOnCancellation avoids the hang.
sofia: toggling keepAlive? could be platform TCP/TLS + VPN interaction.
marco: disabling keepAlive removed repro but can't ship that.
dev-bot: Issue created: #5143 "okhttp cancel reuse stall on Pixel+VPN"
james: pragmatic SDK fix: provide a Kotlin suspend wrapper that registers invokeOnCancellation to cancel the underlying Call. add sample and opt-in flag in SDK builder.
sofia: also add onboarding note: Pixel+VPN keepalive edge-case and workaround.
marco: drafting PR with helper + device integration test (Pixel7/8 + VPN). will link issue.
dev-bot: CI started for pr/1312 (draft)
james: once CI green, ship opt-in and consider making default after more testing.
sofia: marked triage-needed. thanks all :raised_hands:
